note: Day one for the two-pie fund: build both pies from cash, half the money in each. Pie A is unchanged from this morning: VWRP at its core, tilted to Value, Momentum and Quality, the US and Japan, plus Apple, Eli Lilly and TSMC. Pie B's 12 stocks come from 160 candidates and currently lean defensive: energy (Shell, Exxon, Chevron), healthcare (J&J, AbbVie, Lilly, Merck), financials (JPMorgan, Visa, Allianz), Coca-Cola and Apple. That's because those names have the strongest, steadiest trends right now. Roku and Lantheus ranked 1st and 3rd but were skipped: both have agreed takeovers that pin their prices, so there's little upside left. No market warning signs, so both pies are fully invested. Apple and Lilly sit in both pies, so the whole-fund view nets them to 7% and 6%.
